points.point: Can Blotato be white-labeled under our agency's brand?
points.sentence: No. Blotato does not offer whitelabeling, and there are no plans to add whitelabeling.

points.point: Can we resell it to clients as our own product?
points.sentence: Your customers would never see the Blotato name. This is NOT supported.

verdict.reason: The whitelabel entry says rebranding Blotato as your own product, so clients never see the Blotato name, is not supported. That answers both the white-label and the resell-under-our-brand questions.
